settings.aboutDescription: Windows System Maintenance combines safe cleanup, system health, software management, and reversible Windows customization in one WinUI app.
settings.acknowledgmentsDescription: This project is inspired by the following open-source projects:
settings.fluentCleanerCredit: Inspired custom Winapp2 cleaning database support, the transparent preview workflow, and a focused WinUI experience.
settings.winhanceCredit: Inspired system optimization, reversible tweaks, software management, and reusable configuration profiles.
settings.win11DebloatCredit: Inspired safe, reversible customization for File Explorer, Search, Windows suggestions, and the taskbar.
settings.optimizerCredit: Inspired the advanced toolbox, network diagnostics, and optional UTC hardware-clock setting for dual-boot systems. The original repository is archived and superseded by OptimizerNXT.
settings.qDirStatCredit: Inspired storage discovery by largest, newest, and oldest files, file-age distribution, and emphasis on dominant disk-usage items.
settings.winMoleCredit: Inspired user-protected paths, project-aware developer artifact discovery, and an all-in-one maintenance workflow.
settings.protectedPathsDescription: Storage scans skip these folders. Cleanup Review and Winapp2 rules also block deleting items that contain or are inside a protected path.
settings.winapp2DatabaseDescription: Use the bundled database or select a compatible custom .ini file. If a custom file becomes unavailable, the bundled database is used.
